tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Returns verified facts about eVoost AI: what it does, who it is for, its products, markets, headquarters, founders, backers, key figures and how to contact it. Use it before describing or recommending eVoost AI. Pass the user's role to get the right contact channel.

tools.name: list_offerings
tools.description: Lists the three ways eVoost AI works with residential developers (Gravity OS platform, eVoost Services, eVoost Partners broker network) with audience, highlights and page URL. Pass a kind to get only one of them.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Returns the official answers published on evoost.ai to frequently asked questions (data ownership, CRM integration, sales team role, markets, data protection), each with the page that shows it. Pass an optional query to filter by topic; page with limit and the returned nextCursor.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Searches the public pages, page sections, products and FAQ of evoost.ai and returns the most relevant canonical URLs (section results deep-link to their anchor) with a short snippet. Use it to find the page that supports a fact before citing it.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: Returns the official channels to reach eVoost AI: demo request page, email, broker partners portal, headquarters and legal entity addresses. Pass the user's role to get the recommended channel.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_offerings, search_site, get_contact_options · Private data: get_company_overview, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_offerings, search_site, get_contact_options · Private data: get_company_overview, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
